scientific_support_gates.variant_change_indicator: within the same model_seed and episode_id, variant tuple (predicted_belief,predicted_transition,ignited) differs from base tuple; point rate is changed pairs divided by all 160 seed-episode pairs; probability-only changes do not count

attribution_engineering.metric_policy: threshold attribution probability at 0.5; report micro precision and recall against attribution_targets with exact TP/FP/FN denominators; no minimum scientific support threshold is imposed and negative values remain visible

artifacts.unknown_key_policy: reject at every nested canonical object
artifacts.derived_outputs_must_recalculate_from_ra: confusion, calibration, Pareto, variant, residual, attribution and support gates recalculate from per_transition_predictions; loss/objective/gradient aggregates recalculate from loss_ablation_metrics.training_step_rows

confusion_matrices.json.confusion_nested: transition_confusion is an exact object keyed by each frozen target label whose value is an exact object keyed by each frozen predicted label with nonnegative integer counts; maintain_ovr and update_ovr are exact objects with tn,fp,fn,tp nonnegative integer counts

pareto_frontier.json.variant_gate_fields: exact object keys distractor_change,same_id_change,correlated_copy_change; each exact value has changed_pairs,denominator,rate,maximum,passed
pareto_frontier.json.bootstrap_interval_fields: exact object keyed in determinism.bootstrap_algorithm.comparison_order; each exact value has effect,lower,upper,resamples,bootstrap_seed; numeric values are finite or all effect/lower/upper null on failed seed

conditions.oracle_policy: I2 is diagnostic-only and forbidden for training, checkpoint selection, calibration, headline support, or autonomous-input/entity claims
conditions.e2_policy: C13 E2 learned slots remain unimplemented and prohibited

dependencies.c15_source_pin: pending separate preregistration amendment after source-only commit

determinism.paired_bootstrap_unit: primary test cell only; variants stay paired and are not independently resampled

bootstrap_algorithm.draws: one random.Random(4315) consumed in comparison_order; for each of 10000 resamples draw 5 seed positions with replacement, then for each drawn seed and each world in frozen world_order draw 8 test fixture indices with replacement; all conditions and variants use the same sampled blocks
bootstrap_algorithm.failed_seed: if any required seed failed, the comparison effect and interval are null and engineering status is implementation_failure; failed seeds are never dropped or imputed
bootstrap_algorithm.percentile: sort 10000 finite effects; rank=(n-1)*p for p=0.025 and 0.975; linearly interpolate floor and ceil ranks

determinism.pythonhashseed_reproduction: run twice with distinct values and require all eight files byte-identical

input_and_leakage.target_separation: targets are evaluator-side objects unavailable to the model/controller before prediction
input_and_leakage.target_permutation_test: permuting truth and transition targets changes target_hash and loss only; model input bytes, input_hash, and pre-loss predictions remain identical
input_and_leakage.causal_prefix_test: changing a future suffix cannot change any earlier production output
input_and_leakage.identifier_policy: every production-visible episode, family, evidence, source, group, channel, and entity identifier uses the frozen opaque SHA-256 derivation and exposes no readable split, world, transition, truth, or class token; episode_seed and evaluator inventory are never model input
input_and_leakage.official_belief_r: runner rejects any path, cache, argument, metadata, or selection input referring to official Belief-R

input_tracks.I0_whole_hash: zero vector except index int.from_bytes(sha256(canonical visible evidence object).digest()[0:8],'big')%8 is 1.0 and index 11 is 1.0; evaluator fields excluded
input_tracks.I1_local_compositional: indices 0:3 hypothesis alpha/beta/gamma one-hot; 3 support indicator; 4 contradict indicator; 5 strength; 6 clamp(time/25,0,1); 7:10 one-hot stable source bucket int.from_bytes(sha256(source_id).digest()[0:8],'big')%3; 10 same-correlation-as-first-delivery indicator; 11 constant 1.0
input_tracks.I2_symbolic_oracle: indices 0:3 evaluator target truth one-hot; 3 sufficient-information indicator; indices 4:11 zero; index 11 constant 1.0; diagnostic-only and isolated from every train/select/calibrate/headline path
input_tracks.entity_conditions: E0_global applies fixture_generator.ledger_adapter E0 mapping to evidence IDs, model runtime, ledger and controller scope; E1_oracle_entity copies the opaque fixture evidence/entity IDs; neither implements or evaluates E2 learned slots

model_contract.architecture: per-evidence Linear(12,16)+tanh; Linear(16,4) router softmax and deterministic top-2 with lower module-index tie break; four independent Linear(16,16)+tanh module transforms; mean selected module output feeds GRUCell(16,16) with entity-keyed hidden state; separate Linear(16,3) belief head; four separate Linear(16,1) maintain/update/recovery/abstention heads; Linear(16,1) attribution head applied to each of five evidence encodings
model_contract.entity_runtime: hidden state dictionary keyed by evaluated entity; reset only at episode boundary; detach after each optimizer step; no cross-entity reads or writes
model_contract.initialization: torch.manual_seed(model_seed); PyTorch default module initializers in construction order exactly as architecture lists layers; no later reinitialization
model_contract.candidate_aggregation: encode each non-padding assessment evidence, compute router/module output per evidence, mean those outputs in delivery order before GRU; an all-padding row is invalid
model_contract.conditional_belief: softmax of belief logits divided by selected temperature
model_contract.transition_logits: dedicated maintain, update, recovery and abstention scalar heads; no head shares a final Linear parameter tensor with another head

objective_config.gradient_norm: arithmetic mean over optimizer steps of the global L2 norm from torch.autograd.grad before backward; missing gradients are zero; weighted norm is exactly zero when lambda is zero
objective_config.optimizer: torch.optim.Adam learning_rate=0.01, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0.0, amsgrad=false
objective_config.training_data_order: base variant only; batch size one episode; 64 manifest rows in frozen order; no shuffle and no drop; one optimizer step per episode per epoch; 64*6=384

losses.attribution: BCEWithLogits over five candidate slots, reduced as the mean over non-padding slots only, target 1 exactly for attribution_target IDs and 0 otherwise; zero when all slots are padding
losses.belief: CrossEntropyLoss with class weights (1,1,1), mean over sufficient assessment rows only, against alpha/beta/gamma truth
losses.calibration: mean over sufficient assessment rows of sum over alpha/beta/gamma of (conditional_softmax-one_hot_truth)^2
losses.load_balance: for all model calls in the current episode, compute q=mean router softmax per module then mean_j((q_j-0.25)^2); the episode is the optimizer batch
losses.maintain: on all sufficient assessment rows, BCEWithLogits(maintain_logit,1[target maintain]) mean plus coefficient 1.0 times mean absolute alpha/beta/gamma conditional-probability change from the detached pre-assessment probabilities on maintain rows only
losses.no_ignition: BCEWithLogits(abstention_logit,1[target insufficient_information]) mean over every assessment row
losses.recovery: on all sufficient assessment rows, BCEWithLogits(recovery_logit,1[target recover]) mean plus coefficient 1.0 times relu(0.15-state_before.activation[target_truth]) mean on recover rows only; state_before is captured immediately before assessment deliveries
losses.sparsity: mean over all episode model calls of -sum_j(router_p_j*log(max(router_p_j,1e-12)))/log(4)
losses.update: on all sufficient assessment rows, BCEWithLogits(update_logit,1[target update]) mean plus coefficient 1.0 times softplus(-(truth_logit-previous_truth_logit)) mean on update rows only; logits are the assessment pre-temperature belief logits

objective_config.composite_empty_component: an empty drift, ranking, or residual-floor component is exactly 0.0; its BCE component remains evaluated on its declared sufficient mask
objective_config.gradient_parameter_set: all model named_parameters with requires_grad true, sorted lexicographically by name; concatenate each available gradient flattened in that order and take sqrt(sum(square)); None contributes no values and an empty vector is 0.0
objective_config.zero_eligible_rule: raw loss and both gradient norms are 0.0 with eligible_count 0
objective_config.one_weighted_ce: same architecture, initialization, data order, optimizer, steps, checkpoint and calibration budget; CrossEntropyLoss with class weights (1,1,1,1) over alpha/beta/gamma/NO_IGNITION has weight 1 and every C15 auxiliary lambda is exactly zero; transition targets are not exposed

release_freeze.policy: no package 0.3.0, release manifest regeneration, schema reinterpretation, no-Git archive, or private-bundle work before C20

metrics.prediction_transition: insufficient_information when ignited is false; otherwise recover when the ignited belief equals an older predicted belief separated by a different ignited belief, update when it differs from the immediately previous ignited belief, maintain otherwise
metrics.unnecessary_revision_rate: target maintain and predicted transition update/recover divided by target-maintain rows
metrics.missed_revision_rate: target update/recover and predicted transition not update/recover divided by target-update/recover rows
metrics.revision_precision_recall: standard TP/FP/FN over revision_positive_labels; zero denominator is null
metrics.recovery: denominator is exogenous target-recover rows; success requires predicted belief equals truth, predicted transition recover, and checkpoint_restored false; latency is 1 or 2 assessment settle passes, failures are right-censored at 3 and reported separately
metrics.no_ignition: positive target is insufficient_information and positive prediction is ignited false; report precision, recall, false ignition, and missed ignition with null zero denominators
metrics.accuracy_coverage: accuracy is predicted_belief equals truth over all rows; coverage is ignited rows divided by all rows; retained old belief during no-Ignition is not coverage
metrics.calibration: construct four probabilities: NO_IGNITION=p_abstain and each belief=(1-p_abstain)*softmax_belief; all-row multiclass Brier is sum squared error and NLL is -log(max(target_probability,1e-12)); binary abstention Brier is squared error
metrics.ece: decided rows only, confidence=max conditional belief probability, correctness=predicted belief equals truth, ten fixed bins [0.0,0.1),...,[0.9,1.0]; weighted absolute accuracy-confidence gap; no decided rows gives null and coverage remains explicit
metrics.confusions: four-class target/prediction 4x4 counts in frozen transition label order plus maintain and update one-vs-rest TN/FP/FN/TP
metrics.aggregation: seed rows use exact matching raw stratum; aggregate rows pool all five seeds without macro reweighting; every denominator and count is retained; empty metrics are null

nested_raw_contract.attribution_probability_items: exactly five delivery-order slots; padding has evidence_id null and probability null; non-padding has opaque ID and finite [0,1] probability
nested_raw_contract.attribution_targets: sorted unique list of zero to two opaque evidence ID strings
nested_raw_contract.belief_probability_semantics: conditional three-class softmax after selected temperature and before abstention composition; finite [0,1], sum within 1e-12 of 1
nested_raw_contract.citations: sorted unique opaque evidence ID strings
nested_raw_contract.history: ordered list of prior accepted winner labels from alpha/beta/gamma; repeats retained
nested_raw_contract.activations: exact object with alpha,beta,gamma finite nonnegative values
nested_raw_contract.state_nulls: winner is alpha/beta/gamma or null; entity_key and state_hash are nonempty strings
nested_raw_contract.stage_trace: ordered context stages followed by assessment; each exact object has stage_index,stage_role,delivery_rows,input_hash,gate_passes,proposal,learned_decision,state_before,state_after; gate_passes is a length-two list of exact objects with pass_index and proposal, pass_index 1 then 2; every proposal and learned_decision is an exact object with ignited,belief_key,object_key,score,margin,reason,citation_ids; delivery row keys are evidence_id,source_id,correlation_group,entity_key,hypothesis_id,polarity,strength,time,redelivery
nested_raw_contract.transition_probability_semantics: softmax of abstention, maintain, recover, update logits in the frozen key order; finite [0,1], sum within 1e-12 of 1; veto uses the separately specified sigmoid logits, not this normalization

pareto.dominance: A dominates B when A is no worse on every finite dimension within epsilon 1e-12 and strictly better on at least one by more than epsilon; any null makes the pair incomparable; equality is not dominance
pareto.noninferiority: point estimates only in the frozen cell: for loss metrics full-minus-one_weighted_ce <= the named max-increase margin; for gain metrics full-minus-one_weighted_ce >= negative named max-decrease margin
pareto.strict_improvement: point estimates only; require at least one of CE-minus-full for unnecessary, missed, or ECE, or full-minus-CE for recovery rate or no-ignition F1, to be >=0.02; no post-hoc dimension selection
pareto.multiplicity: intervals are descriptive; no p-value or familywise significance claim

selection.calibration_dev: dev episode indices 4-7 within each world
selection.calibration_metric: all-row belief Brier plus binary abstention Brier; lexical tie-break temperature then abstention threshold
selection.checkpoint_selection_dev: dev episode indices 0-3 within each world
selection.checkpoint_selection_metric: weighted objective total; tie-break earlier epoch
order: commit and independently audit source plus focused tests without executing official train/dev/test seeds
amend only the four authorized protocol pin fields and enable the runner
train fixed configurations inside the first official runner execution
select temperature and abstention threshold on disjoint calibration-dev
selection.test_reuse: forbidden; any change after test inspection requires a new Decision ID and protocol

source_control.preflight: working bytes equal HEAD; base protocol blob hash and authorized amendment match; git diff preregistration-base..c15-source-pin --name-only is nonempty and an exact subset of c15_authorized_paths_before_pin, with no v02_deny_paths, release, schema, C14 protected, or other path; source pin is an ancestor and all runtime/test authorized paths are unchanged from source pin to HEAD except the separately validated protocol-only pin amendment and later result documentation/artifacts; all protected hashes pass before output creation

splits.canonical_manifest_document: canonical JSON of {rows:[{episode_id,episode_seed,family_id,world}],schema_version:'0.3',split}; keys sorted, UTF-8, no spaces

generator.row_order: world outer loop in world_order, integer i inner loop ascending

fixture_generator.evidence_record: for stage integer and slot integer: source_id='src-'+H('c15-source|'+family_id+'|'+str(stage)+'|'+str(slot)), correlation_group='grp-'+H('c15-group|'+family_id+'|'+str(stage)+'|'+str(slot)), time=float(stage*10+slot); canonical body keys are correlation_group,entity_key,hypothesis_id,polarity,source_id,strength,time; evidence_id='ev-'+H('c15-evidence|'+canonical_json(body).decode('utf-8'))
fixture_generator.stage_numbering: context stages are numbered from 0; assessment is always stage 2 so its event time and IDs remain paired across worlds

variants.irrelevant_distractor: append slot 4 support for C with strength 0.25 and independent frozen source/group derivation
variants.same_id_duplicate: append an exact byte-identical redelivery of assessment slot 0; ledger unique candidate set is unchanged
variants.correlated_copy: append a byte-identical copy of assessment slot 0 except evidence_id='ev-'+H('c15-correlated|'+original_evidence_id); source_id and correlation_group remain identical

fixture_generator.attribution_target: assessment candidate IDs whose unmodified stage spec has hypothesis target_truth and polarity support; exact duplicate, correlated copy, distractor, padding, context evidence, contradiction, and evaluator citation flags are excluded
fixture_generator.candidate_slots: five slots in delivery order; missing unique records are masked padding; same-ID redelivery is recorded in delivery trace but occupies no new candidate slot
fixture_generator.full_fixture_document: canonical JSON using the splits.generator canonical_json call; document keys exactly episodes,schema_version,split; episode order equals split manifest and variant order is frozen

full_fixture_schema.context_stages: list of stage delivery lists only, with no stage wrapper; maintain/update/insufficient contain [generated establish_A at stage 0], recover contains [generated establish_A at stage 0, generated establish_B_contradict_A at stage 1]
full_fixture_schema.evidence_types: all IDs/hypothesis/polarity strings; strength and time finite JSON numbers; polarity support or contradict
full_fixture_schema.assessment_deliveries: list of exact evidence objects; build the world assessment stage at stage 2 from stage_specs in listed slot order, then apply exactly one frozen variant rule
full_fixture_schema.attribution_targets: list in assessment stage delivery order before variant modification, containing only original target-truth support evidence IDs
full_fixture_schema.construction_pseudocode: for manifest row derive A/B/C and entity; generate each named stage by replacing A/B/C symbols, passing the declared stage integer and each [slot,hypothesis,polarity,strength] to evidence_record; choose previous_truth/target/sufficiency from world_sequences; for each variant in variants.order shallow-copy every assessment evidence object, apply its rule, and append exact variant object; append exact episode object; finally canonicalize exact document
full_fixture_schema.unknown_keys: forbidden at every document, episode, variant, and evidence object

ledger_adapter.purpose: the frozen eight-field fixture evidence is the model/evaluator document; this adapter alone supplies the existing strict C13 EvidenceRecord lineage fields before ledger insertion
ledger_adapter.entity_condition_mapping: adapter requires entity_condition. E1_oracle_entity copies fixture entity_key and evidence_id. E0_global sets entity_key='__global__' and evidence_id='ev-'+H('c15-e0|'+fixture_evidence_id). Every other fixture field is copied exactly. The same fixture ID always maps to the same E0 ID; distinct correlated-copy IDs remain distinct
ledger_adapter.attribution_mapping: map every fixture attribution target ID through the same E0/E1 evidence-ID rule before loss and evaluation
ledger_adapter.registration_order: for each first-seen evidence_id, ledger.register_sample(sample_id), then ledger.register_spark(spark_id,(sample_id,)), then ledger.add(EvidenceRecord); exact same-ID redelivery skips registration and calls ledger.add with the byte-identical previously built EvidenceRecord
ledger_adapter.fixed_added_values: metadata={}, parent_evidence_ids=(), parent_spark_ids=(spark_id,), schema_version='0.3'; after the explicit entity-condition mapping, the other seven fixture fields are copied without reinterpretation
ledger_adapter.identity_policy: the adapter is deterministic and prediction-independent; only the preregistered E0/E1 mapping may change entity_key/evidence_id, while condition, input track, model seed and variant may not

state_and_gate.c14_composition: C14 bounded gate evaluates attributable EvidenceLedger candidates before any belief mutation; learned abstention may veto but never force ignition
state_and_gate.activation_mapping: for each alpha/beta/gamma conditional softmax probability p, pass nonnegative activation -log(max(1-p,1e-12)) to unchanged C14; C14's frozen 1-exp(-activation) normalization therefore equals p up to the clamp
state_and_gate.stage_evidence_scope: before each context or assessment stage insertion, on the trial ledger deactivate every active row for the evaluated entity whose adapted evidence_id is absent from the current stage, using that stage's frozen settle time as the intervention time; preserve immutable records and audit history, leave other entities untouched, reject any fixture requiring restore of an earlier-stage inactive ID, then insert current deliveries in frozen order; an exact same-ID duplicate within the stage remains a byte-identical redelivery no-op
state_and_gate.gate_settle: after all deliveries for each context or assessment stage, call the same entity-local C14 gate twice at now=stage*10+5 with unchanged ledger and activations; pass 1 advances C14 stability only and never mutates belief; pass 2 is the sole proposal eligible for learned veto and belief update
state_and_gate.evaluated_entity_key: versioned C15 decision field required even when C14 returns object_key null
state_and_gate.learned_veto: if C14 rejects, preserve its reason. If C14 proposes and sigmoid(abstention_logit)>=calibrated threshold, veto as learned_insufficient_information. Otherwise initial establishment is accepted without a transition-head veto; if proposed belief equals current winner require sigmoid(maintain_logit)>=0.5; if it equals an older winner separated by a different winner require sigmoid(recovery_logit)>=0.5; otherwise require sigmoid(update_logit)>=0.5. Failure reasons are maintain_head_below_threshold, recovery_head_below_threshold, update_head_below_threshold in that priority after abstention
state_and_gate.veto_trace: a learned veto preserves C14 coalition rows, score, margin, proposed belief, and support/contradiction citations in the trace but emits ignited=false, belief_key=null, object_key=null and performs only the frozen entity-local no-Ignition decay
state_and_gate.no_ignition_update: decay only the evaluated entity once; retain candidate activations and citations; never clear or force a prediction
state_and_gate.recovery: within one episode and one in-memory entity state, A establishes, B suppresses, and A returns; no reset, model reinstantiation, checkpoint load, or checkpoint restore after episode start
state_and_gate.residual: loser activation retained at factor 0.92 after entity-local decay 0.88; no_residual sets loser retention to 0.0 while all future evidence, weights, thresholds, and ordering remain paired
call_order: deactivate prior-stage active evidence for the evaluated entity on the trial ledger
evaluate unchanged C14 bounded gate in two mutation-free settle passes
apply learned abstention and transition-head veto without mutation
update only evaluated entity belief state

transition_contract.first_sufficient_step: maintain after initial establishment context; assessment rows never use an unestablished first step
transition_contract.history_scope: truth history is per episode and evaluated entity only
precedence: insufficient if causal available evidence has fewer than two independent sources or groups
recover if sufficient truth equals an earlier truth separated by at least one different sufficient truth
update if sufficient truth differs from the immediately previous sufficient truth
transition_contract.prediction_independence: derived only from latent world truth history and causal evidence availability before model execution; never from predictions, thresholds, ignition, checkpoints, or learned state
transition_contract.recovery_window: the entire current episode before the assessment step

variants.same_id_duplicate: exact same EvidenceRecord redelivery and therefore exact ledger no-op
variants.correlated_copy: distinct evidence ID in the same correlation group with C13 discount
variants.irrelevant_distractor: new attributable evidence for a non-target hypothesis and unrelated source/group

worlds.insufficient: established A context followed by an assessment with fewer than two independent causal supports
worlds.maintain: established A context followed by sufficient consistent A evidence
worlds.recover: sufficient A then sufficient B then sufficient A assessment with unchanged in-memory state
worlds.update: established A context followed by sufficient contradictory B evidence
